svg.title: Vocabloom architecture
svg.desc: The teacher uploads a PDF to a Vercel function in Dublin, which asks the Claude API to build the worksheet and optionally uses Upstash Redis. Students open the worksheet on their phones, where all their answers stay.
svg.text: Small on purpose: no accounts, no runtime dependencies, nothing about students on any server.
